functions.residue: RESIDUE REGPERM 35 r3->ip ip->r3 r3->sb sl->r1 r1->r3 r8->sb
functions.description: build combat selection record from script entry
functions.lever: interleave vectors[2]/[3] statements (v2.y, v3.x = field6c & 0x3ff, v2.z, v3.y, v3.z); read entry->params[i] through a getter with a local; declare entry as a bare local before slot/result
functions.notes: Size, frame layout, shape and schedule all match; 35 bytes of register colouring are left in two places. (1) Timer word at 0x40c-0x430: the ROM puts the selection word in r3 and field72 in ip, and the masked word reuses r3. Ours swaps r3 and ip and puts the masked word in sb. Moving timer/timerLimit/fieldf4 and binding field72 to a local did not fix it. (2) The groupFlags bit loop at 0x4dc-0x518: the ROM puts the hoisted base in sl, the list cursor in r1, the bit in r4 and the constant 1 in r8. Ours puts the base in r1 and the cursor in r3. These made no difference: bare-declaration orders, a function-scope counter, an inline SetGroupFlag (member or free; the out-of-line copy is func_020865b8) and colorsweep. In the ROM, result (r5) is never set on the entry!=NULL path, so the source leaves result uninitialised there to match. v3.x needs an explicit '& 0x3ff' to get the ROM's second mask; readback and chained-assignment forms overgenerate.
